title: Device (GPIO)
author: Atlas core
description: Switch and read the physical world from a process: drive a named output of a device on or off, read one of its outputs or inputs, or pulse an output for a bounded time. A model names the device's Worker and a line by its name — never a pin; which pin a name is wired to is the device's own configuration, and its worker runs on the device itself, connecting out to this server (ADR-draft-device-workers-for-the-physical-world). Every output has a safe state the device returns to at start, at shutdown and when its own watchdog's limit runs out, so a lost server or a cancelled process cannot leave a valve open. A write and a read may run twice without harm; a pulse is run once per job, however often the job is delivered. A job the device cannot run — a line it does not have, a pulse longer than its limit — fails without retries.

properties.label: Worker
properties.description: Name of the device's Worker (Console → Workers), e.g. pi-gewaechshaus. The worker on that device serves it.

properties.label: Output (switch, pulse)
properties.description: The output's name in the device's wiring, e.g. relais.

properties.label: Line (read)
properties.description: The name of an output or an input in the device's wiring, e.g. taster.

properties.label: On (switch, pulse)
properties.description: true or false, or a FEEL expression. A pulse is on unless this says false.

properties.label: Duration in ms (pulse)
properties.description: How long the pulse holds, at most 60000. Anything longer is a switch on, a timer and a switch off.

properties.label: Result variable (read)
properties.description: Receives {on: true|false}. Required on Read a line.
